meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 它先分析你改过的代码,把每处改动和目的记成一份迁移指南;升级时先用干净的上游代码,再按指南把改动重新放回去,代替容易冲突的合并。
howto.when: 当你准备把自定义过的 NanoClaw 仓库升级到上游新版本,或直接输入 /migrate-nanoclaw 时触发。

say.text: 我要升级到上游最新版,先帮我提取我的自定义改动
say.note: Claude 会开始分析你的改动并制作迁移指南。

say.text: 生成一份迁移指南,把配置和源码改动都记下来
say.note: 结果会保存为可在升级时重放的 Markdown 指南。

say.text: 升级时用干净代码重新应用我的改动,别用合并
say.note: 会在干净上游代码上按指南逐项重放改动,避免冲突。

howto.what_en: It analyzes the code you changed, records each modification plus its purpose into a migration guide; on upgrade it starts from clean upstream code and reapplies the changes from the guide, replacing merge-based updates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version, or when you run /migrate-nanoclaw.

say_en.text: I want to upgrade to latest upstream — extract my custom changes first
say_en.note: Claude starts analyzing your changes and building the guide.

say_en.text: Generate a migration guide covering config and source changes
say_en.note: Saved as a Markdown guide replayable at upgrade time.

say_en.text: On upgrade, reapply my changes on clean code instead of merging
say_en.note: Replays changes from the guide onto a clean upstream base.
